% A guard, for files of the document named like a .4ht file: a copy of
% TeX Live's cp1252.def in the document's folder, which inputenc reads in
% place of the tree's. No other fixture reads cp1252.def, so the copy
% changes no other page; replace it with the tree's file after an update
% of LaTeX. As in the PDF, the degree sign is a degree sign, set as
% cp1252.4ht sets it.
\documentclass{article}
\IfFileExists{./cp1252.def}{}{\errmessage{No copy of cp1252.def beside the document}}
\usepackage[cp1252]{inputenc}
\begin{document}
An angle of 30\textdegree.
\end{document}
